title: Select supported vector instructions with a correct scalar fallback
goal: Select exact supported instruction families and signed SVE loop predicates while preserving a scalar numeric fallback; experimental SVE and advanced-hardware execution is not tested.

selectionNotes: Experimental Arm SVE requires scoped SYSLIB5003 opt-in and AllowUnsafeBlocks=true for masked memory operations.
Exact IsSupported flags guard all ISA-specific calls; architecture or vector width alone is insufficient.
SVE/SVE2 and AVX-VNNI-512 execution are not tested because suitable CPUs are unavailable. No other hardware is required; compilation and x64 fallback do not establish native behavior.
Not tested: SVE/SVE2 and AVX-VNNI-512 execution: unavailable CPUs. Excluded under PIN-699; x64 AVX2/scalar checks do not cover these paths.

runtime.name: .NET
runtime.reason: Use the .NET 11 vector and instruction contracts.

sdk.name: .NET SDK
sdk.reason: Build against the .NET 11 reference assemblies; exact RC2 is the recorded test baseline.

language.name: C#
language.reason: Canonical language mode; SVE is an experimental library API rather than preview C# syntax.

platforms: Any supported .NET 11 platform for scalar fallback; x86/x64 AVX2 or exact AVX512-VNNI support for the corresponding path; Arm64 SVE exposed by OS/runtime for SVE
prerequisites: SDK console project targeting net11.0 with ImplicitUsings=enable, Nullable=enable and namespace Playbook.Samples; include all supplied canonical declarations and imports.
AllowUnsafeBlocks=true for SVE pointers; scoped #pragma warning disable SYSLIB5003 and restore as supplied.
constraints: Experimental Arm SVE requires scoped SYSLIB5003 opt-in and AllowUnsafeBlocks=true for masked memory operations.
Exact IsSupported flags guard all ISA-specific calls; architecture or vector width alone is insufficient.
SVE/SVE2 and AVX-VNNI-512 execution are not tested because suitable CPUs are unavailable. No other hardware is required; compilation and x64 fallback do not establish native behavior.
No extra NuGet package/assets, provider, workload or rendering mode. No older-target package route or general performance guarantee is established.
optIns: #pragma warning disable SYSLIB5003 around experimental SVE usage, restored afterward; AllowUnsafeBlocks=true for SVE pointer access.
stabilityLimitations: Arm SVE/SVE2/SveSha3/SveSm4 contracts are publisher-designated experimental and may change. RC2 is not GA evidence.
SVE/SVE2 and AVX-VNNI-512 native execution are explicitly excluded under PIN-699. This limitation remains untested and does not block publication.
Not tested: SVE/SVE2 and AVX-VNNI-512 execution: unavailable CPUs. Excluded under PIN-699; x64 AVX2/scalar checks do not cover these paths.

evidence.scope: Both actual target builds compile all declared sample code and execute only x64 AVX2 dispatch with scalar agreement, lengths/tails and overflow. SVE and AVX-VNNI-512 paths remain unexecuted; required-mode checks explicitly fail on this host. No mocks, cross-compilation or GA verification.
